title: Craftable Totem of Undying recipe
description: A simple datapack that lets you craft totem of undying in a crafting table
body:
The totem of undying is truly one of minecraft's most useful items, with it being able to save it last second from a lot of difficult situation, so you can't really have enough of them right?
Well look no further, this datapack adds a simple yet balanced recipe to craft them.



![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c94575c51ba711849141e71fd361d22401fa63d.png)
